positioning: A privacy-first Windows energy planner for ADHD and other variable-capacity days.
name: Ample
shortDescription: Plan a realistic day around the energy you have, with no account, cloud, ads, or record sync.
description:
Ample is a privacy-first Windows energy planner for ADHD and other variable-capacity days. It helps you make a realistic plan from the capacity you have, not the capacity a calendar assumes.

CHOOSE YOUR CAPACITY
Set a daily energy budget from 4 to 24. Ample never infers or changes that budget from a diagnosis or check-in.

PLAN BY ENERGY
Give each task a priority, expected duration, and energy demand. Ample estimates a spoon cost, subtracts completed work from the day's budget, and can show up to three open tasks whose recorded cost fits the energy left.

START WITH TODAY
Recent mood, energy, and sleep check-ins shape a plain-language daily briefing and one suggested practice. These are conservative local rules, not AI, diagnosis, treatment, or clinical monitoring.

MAKE THE NEXT STEP SMALLER
Smart Decompose can replace one task with a short set of starter steps in a single local transaction. Nothing is sent to a remote service.

REVIEW YOUR OWN RHYTHM
See mood, energy, and sleep across 7, 14, or 30 days. When you request it, Ample can save a personal session-summary PDF to a location you choose. The summary is a reflection aid, not a clinical record.

LOCAL AND ENCRYPTED AT REST
Ample has no account, advertising, record sync, cloud API, or app telemetry. SQLite runs in memory while Ample is open. At rest, records are stored as authenticated AES-256-GCM snapshots with a random 256-bit key protected by Windows DPAPI through Electron safeStorage. Ample fails closed if protected key storage is unavailable. During upgrades from older versions, a temporary encrypted migration backup is retired after two verified encrypted generations.

These protections are not an absolute security guarantee. Records and the key are decrypted in memory while the app is open, and Windows may copy memory into swap, hibernation, crash, or diagnostic storage. Someone controlling the signed-in Windows session may be able to access the same credential facility. User-requested JSON and PDF exports are plaintext, and deleting old files cannot guarantee removal from SSD recovery, snapshots, or backups. Read the privacy policy before entering sensitive information.

SECONDARY TOOLS
Ample also includes local check-ins, guided breathing, grounding, a body scan, focus blocks, and a user-written crisis plan. ERP, diary-card, and medication-reference modules are preserved outside the default navigation pending dedicated opt-in and safety review. Ample does not issue medication reminders, monitor you, or guarantee crisis detection.

Ample is personal organization and wellness software. It is not a medical device, healthcare or emergency service, diagnosis, treatment, or substitute for professional care. In a US crisis, call or text 988; in immediate danger, call the local emergency number.

Local mood, energy, anxiety, and sleep check-ins

Transactional Smart Decompose for smaller starter steps
